messages:
alyssa (support): FYI — ACME reports voucher 'ACME-MAR-50' applied in UI but API usage isn't decrementing their voucher balance. UI shows grant txn, but API calls appear to consume tokens without debiting the voucher. Org: org_acme_42. Started after they linked a subaccount. :thinking:

mira (billing): can you paste org id, sample curl, and the event id from their dashboard? I'll check ledger flows.

alyssa (support): Org: org_acme_42
Sample curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME-..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}] }'
```
Response: 200 OK, {"id":"resp_7f8e","tokens_used":24, "billing_event": null}
Request id: req_0a1b2c3d
Customer says voucher grant txn id: txn_9810

ben (eng-infra): :eyes: billing_event null is suspicious. That usually means the consumption wasn't finalized to a ledger. But you said this is non-streaming?

alyssa (support): yes single-shot. No streaming socket. They tested 20 requests, tokens increment in app metrics but voucher balance in UI stays unchanged.

billing-bot: ledger_txns lookup: grant txn_9810 => applied to alias `trial_voucher_org_acme_42` (alias present). Consumption events for req_0a1b2c3d..req_0a1b2c3u exist but are posted to `primary_ledger_org_acme_42`. No consumption posted to `trial_voucher_org_acme_42`.

ben (eng-infra): I can reproduce in staging when an org has a separate grant alias (subaccount mapping). Consumption path resolves alias only for streaming sessions; single-shot path falls back to default ledger and skips alias. Root cause: missing alias lookup on single-shot consume flow when grant has alias metadata.

dan (c-succ): customer is blocked — they're on trial and running integration tests. Can billing do a manual correction while we patch?

mira (billing): yes I can create a manual adjustment to debit the voucher ledger and credit primary so the UI shows usage. Will DM for consent and org owners.

ben (eng-infra): mitigation plan: add alias resolution to single-shot consume flow and a reconciliation job to re-tag recent consumption events where alias should apply. Opened PR r/infra/ledger#3456. Short rollback-safe change: enable alias-fallback boolean.

ben (eng-infra): ETA: review + staged deploy ~4h. Reconcile job will run after hotfix; might take ~30m for this org.

alyssa (support): I'll notify the customer and request consent for manual ledger adj. Also sending repro snippet and request ids to oncall for quicker triage.

mira (billing): done — manual adj queued pending customer ACK. Added internal ticket BILL-5923.

ben (eng-infra): added alert metric for "consumption_event_without_alias" and a dashboard panel. If threshold >0 for >5m we get page on-call.

alyssa (support): thanks team. I'll follow up in thread once billing confirms and after we deploy the fix. :thumbsup:

mira (billing): tagging for postmortem when resolved.

ben (eng-infra): PR linked in thread. keeping this open until reconcile completes.

alyssa (support): closing loop once reconcile completes and customer confirms voucher balance now decrements.
